title: Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Return of the Doomed Labyrinth of Nightmare LON-021 Rare Card

descriptionText: The Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Return of the Doomed from the Labyrinth of Nightmare set is a rare English language collectible card game item. Manufactured by Konami, this spell-normal card is part of the Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG game series. With an attack power and defense of 0, this card is designed for players aged 16 and above who are looking to enhance their card game strategy with the Return of the Doomed character.
